description: This file defines the interface and class implementations for a test reporter system, specifically version 2 of the reporter API, including methods for handling test events, output, errors, and lifecycle hooks.

classes.name: ReporterV2Wrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class that adapts a generic Reporter to the ReporterV2 interface, handling deferred output and lifecycle event forwarding.

methods.name: wrapReporterAsV2
methods.description: Wraps a Reporter or ReporterV2 instance as a ReporterV2, returning the original if already v2.

methods.name: ReporterV2Wrapper.constructor
methods.description: Initializes the wrapper with a Reporter instance.

methods.name: ReporterV2Wrapper.onBegin
methods.description: Invokes the onBegin method of the wrapped reporter and processes any deferred output.

methods.name: ReporterV2Wrapper.onTestBegin
methods.description: Forwards the test start event to the wrapped reporter.

methods.name: ReporterV2Wrapper.onStdOut
methods.description: Handles standard output, deferring if necessary.

methods.name: ReporterV2Wrapper.onStdErr
methods.description: Handles standard error output, deferring if necessary.

methods.name: ReporterV2Wrapper.onEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of testing, forwarding the result.

methods.name: ReporterV2Wrapper.onExit
methods.description: Handles process exit, forwarding the call.

methods.name: ReporterV2Wrapper.onStepBegin
methods.description: Handles the beginning of a test step.

methods.name: ReporterV2Wrapper.onStepEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of a test step.

methods.name: ReporterV2Wrapper.printsToStdio
methods.description: Indicates if the reporter prints to stdio.
